high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "xeeoxee," who has a verified account indicated by the blue checkmark next to their username. The post features a close-up photograph of a decorative butterfly made from what appears to be sugar or fondant, given its smooth texture and vibrant colors. The butterfly has wings that are predominantly blue with a gradient effect, transitioning from a darker shade at the edges to a lighter shade towards the center. The body of the butterfly is a rich, deep red color, providing a striking contrast to the blue wings.
